cd /workspace/task && cat > solve.py << 'EOF'
import openpyxl
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('init.xlsx')
ws = wb['WEEKDAY']
names = '{"Monday","Tuesday","Wednesday","Thursday","Friday","Saturday","Sunday"}'
for r in range(2,17):
    ws.cell(row=r, column=2).value = f'=WEEKDAY(A{r},2)'
    ws.cell(row=r, column=3).value = f'=INDEX({names},WEEKDAY(A{r},2))'
wb.save('output.xlsx')
print('saved')
EOF
python3 solve.py
